_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.49x; -5% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.45; conservative 2yr +35%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.0%/yr (worst year FY99-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-19.5%/yr (Q1 2009 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +12.9%/yr (FY99-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2009-06-19) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.49x (46.2% downside to Bear $28 / +94.2% upside to Bull $101) | Adj composite 1.80 vs market 2.25: gap -0.45 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | -5% above the EPP floor $54 (12x FY09E $4.54) | Conservative 2-yr case: +35.2% total (+17.6%/yr) | At 11.5x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $69 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; carloads -21% in Q1 2009, forward revenue -20% (no FY09 revenue guide, Q1 2009 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2008 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2004-2008, per share restated for the 2008 stock split (diluted EPS 2006 $2.95, 2007 $3.46, 2008 $4.54); 2008 diluted shares 515.0M, effective tax rate 36.1%, interest expense $511M, other income $92M, free cash flow $825M; about 22 million shares repurchased in 2008; quarterly dividend $0.27; 2009 Outlook in words only (no earnings, revenue or volume figure); capital investments of about $2.8 billion

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2006 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2002-2006 (operating revenue, diluted EPS from continuing operations, operating margin and ratio, carloads); 2006 diluted shares 272.0M, effective tax rate 36.4%, interest expense $477M, other income $118M; competition (BNSF parallel routes); 2007 Outlook: commodity revenue growth target 6% to 7%, volume growth 2% to 3%, earnings growth of 10% to 15% and an operating ratio below 80%; quarterly dividend raised to $0.35 on 2007-01-30; 20M-share repurchase authorized 2007-01-30 through 2009

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2004 10-K
sources.supports: ten-year selected financial data 1995-2004 on the continuing-operations basis (trucking reclassified as discontinued): 1998 loss from continuing operations ($0.41 per diluted share), 1999 $3.05, 2000 $3.22 (includes a $72M after-tax work force reduction charge); operating revenue 1999 $10,175M, 2000 $10,765M

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2005 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2001-2005: 2001 diluted EPS from continuing operations $3.65, operating revenues $10,830M

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2001 10-K
sources.supports: 1999 weighted-average diluted shares 269.8M (earnings per share note)

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2005 results (8-K ex.99.1)
sources.supports: company-published EPS excluding one-offs: 2004 $2.89 per diluted share excluding the non-cash asbestos charge ($2.30 reported), 2005 $3.41 excluding the income tax expense reduction ($3.85 reported)

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation FY2007 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2003-2007; 2007 diluted shares 268.4M, effective tax rate 38.4%, interest expense $482M, other income $116M; 2008 Outlook: earnings of $7.75 to $8.25 per diluted share, volume within a range of 1% higher to 1% lower than 2007, fuel prices 15% to 20% above the 2007 average, record revenue and an improved operating ratio in words; capital investments of about $3.1 billion

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q4 2008 results (8-K ex.99.1)
sources.supports: Q4 and full-year 2008 freight revenue statistics by business group (revenue, carloads, average revenue per car), operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS ($4.54 for 2008) and shares, effective tax rate, interest expense and other income, cash, free cash flow, share repurchases; 2009 outlook in words only ('2009 will be a difficult year')

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation Q1 2009 results (8-K ex.99.1)
sources.supports: Q1 2009 freight revenue statistics by business group, operating ratio, GTMs per employee, diluted EPS and shares, cash; no shares repurchased; outlook in words only

sources.title: Union Pacific Corporation 8-K ex.99.1: 2-for-1 stock split, additional share repurchase authorization and second quarter dividend
sources.supports: two-for-one stock split distributed as a stock dividend; repurchase of a further 20 million shares (40 million post-split) by March 2011; quarterly dividend of 44 cents (22 cents post-split)
